name: Firstrade Unofficial API
description: Community-reverse-engineered REST API for Firstrade Securities brokerage platform. Provides account management, equity and option trading, real-time market data, and watchlist functionality. Not an official Firstrade API.

availableChannel.name: Authentication
availableChannel.description: Session login with username/password and MFA (TOTP, PIN, email OTP, SMS OTP)

availableChannel.name: Account Management
availableChannel.description: Account list, balances, positions, and transaction history

availableChannel.name: Order Management
availableChannel.description: Place, preview, list, and cancel equity and option orders

availableChannel.name: Market Data
availableChannel.description: Real-time and delayed stock quotes, OHLC chart data, and option chains with Greeks

availableChannel.name: Watchlists
availableChannel.description: Create, read, update, and delete watchlists and watchlist symbols

offers.name: Commission-Free Trading
offers.description: Firstrade offers commission-free trading of stocks, ETFs, options, and mutual funds with no account minimums.

additionalProperty.name: mfaSupport
additionalProperty.value: TOTP, PIN, email OTP, SMS OTP

subjectOf.name: Stock Trading
subjectOf.description: Commission-free stock and ETF trading including fractional shares

subjectOf.name: Options Trading
subjectOf.description: Options contract trading with Greeks analytics

subjectOf.name: Retirement Accounts
subjectOf.description: IRA, Roth IRA, SEP IRA, SIMPLE IRA brokerage accounts
